page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u1-c1m8.large is an x86_64 architecture virtual server powered by an Intel Xeon processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs derived from 1 physical core with hyper-threading enabled. The memory configuration consists of 16.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps under KVM virtualization.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance, such as stress-ng and Geekbench single-core tests, falls within the average range. However, multi-core CPU performance and memory bandwidth benchmarks—including cached and uncached read/write operations—rank in the bottom 10%. Cryptographic and database operations also show lower-tier performance, with Redis SET operations and static web serving throughput scoring in the lower percentiles.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, this instance offers a high memory-to-vCPU ratio at a low resource tier, making it a qualitative choice for memory-bound workloads that do not require intensive parallel processing or high disk I/O. Due to the lack of local storage and lower multi-core performance, it is best suited for lightweight database caching, basic web serving, or memory-intensive background tasks with low CPU utilization.
